entities.name: Märt Kosemets
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Märt Kosemets is a retired Estonian professional footballer, who last played in the Meistriliiga, for JK Viljandi Tulevik, whom he joined from Flora Tallinn after the 2005 season. He played the position of defender and midfielder. He is 1.80 m tall and weighs 67 kg.
